description: Geo is the second Element the Traveler acquires by resonating with the Statue of The Seven in Liyue .
role_summary: Geo is the second Element the Traveler acquires by resonating with the Statue of The Seven in Liyue .

talents.name: Foreign Rockblade
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 5 rapid strikes. Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes. Plunging Attack Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

talents.name: Starfell Sword
talents.description: You disgorge a meteorite from the depths of the earth, dealing AoE Geo DMG . The meteorite is considered a Geo Construct , and can be climbed or used to block attacks. Hold This skill's positioning may be adjusted.

talents.name: Wake of Earth
talents.description: Energizing the Geo deep underground, you set off expanding shockwaves. Launches surrounding opponents back and deals AoE Geo DMG . A stone wall is erected at the edges of the shockwave. The stone wall is considered a Geo Construct , and may be used to block attacks.

talents.name: Frenzied Rockslide
talents.description: The final hit of a Normal Attack combo triggers a collapse, dealing 60% of ATK as AoE Geo DMG .

talents.name: Foreign Adamantine
talents.description: Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional buffs Additional Buff Effects The Traveler gains an attribute bonus for every element they have resonated with: Anemo : CRIT Rate is increased by 10%, Geo : DEF is increased by 20%, Electro : Energy Recharge is increased by 20%, Dendro : Elemental Mastery is increased by 60, Hydro : HP is increased by 20%, Pyro : ATK is increased by 20%, Cryo : CRIT DMG is increased by 20%. . Additionally, when nearby party members become protected by a shield , when the shield is replaced for any reason, or when Geo Constructs are created, the Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of Archaic Petra, max 3 stacks. Up to 1 stack may be obtained every second in this way. After obtaining 3 stacks of Blade of Archaic Petra, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of Archaic Petra and transform into the special Charged Attack: Rockfell . Charged Attack: Rockfell Each Charged Attack hit deals increased Geo DMG . Increase in DMG is equal to 120% of Traveler's ATK. For 15s after hitting an opponent, nearby party members will have their shield strength temporarily increased by 20%. Ch...

c1.name: Invincible Stonewall
c1.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Party members within the radius of Wake of Earth have their CRIT Rate increased by 10% and have increased resistance against interruption . The area in which the CRIT Rate and Interruption Resistance buff is applied is independent of the Geo Constructs created by Wake of Earth and will persist even if all of the Geo Constructs are destroyed. The CRIT Rate and Interruption Resistance buffs are applied to active characters within the radius of Wake of Earth every second, and persist for 2 seconds per application even if the character leaves the radius. The CRIT Rate increase does not apply to the Elemental Burst that granted it.

c2.name: Rockcore Meltdown
c2.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Preview When the meteorite created by Starfell Sword is destroyed, it will also explode, dealing additional AoE Geo DMG equal to the amount of damage dealt by Starfell Sword. The meteorite explosion follows the default Internal Cooldown of 2.5 seconds/ 3 hits. This ICD is shared with the Skill DMG of Starfell Sword . Hover over previews to view in higher quality. ( Preview Preferences ) Media:Constellation Rockcore Meltdown.mp4

c3.name: Will of the Rock
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Wake of Earth by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Reaction Force
c4.effect: Description Gameplay Notes The shockwave triggered by Wake of Earth regenerates 5 Energy for every opponent hit. A maximum of 25 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time. The energy regeneration is only for the Traveler, and once an enemy triggers this constellation's effect, they cannot trigger it again.

c5.name: Meteorite Impact
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Starfell Sword by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Everlasting Boulder
c6.effect: The barrier created by Wake of Earth lasts 5s longer. The meteorite created by Starfell Sword lasts 10s longer.
